description: Search and filter every tracked Base yield opportunity, with total risk and opportunity scores. Useful for finding candidates and their ids before buying a card, score, history or dependency graph. Free, at most 60 calls an hour per client. Free; at most 60 calls an hour per client.

capital.description: Capital in USD for the expected-return figures (default 10000).

duration.description: Holding period in days for the expected-return figures (default 365).

min_apy.description: Lowest APY to include, in percent.

q.description: Search words over protocol, market and asset names (letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes, underscores; at most 60).

risk_max.description: Highest total risk score to include (0-100, lower is lower modelled risk).

stable_only.description: Only opportunities whose principal is a stablecoin.

name: search_opportunities
